title: SRD 5.1 importer: reference-table parser
description:
**Prerequisites (apply to all SRD 5.1 importer child issues):**
- Vendored SRD 5.1 PDF must be in place at `packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf` — see that directory's README.md.
- Reference implementation: mirror the structure of `packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseSpells.ts` (parser), `emit.ts` (record builder + manifest description), `index.ts` (pipeline wiring), and the test layout under `packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/`.
- Depends on `loreweaver-0m9.5.9` (section detection + orchestrator).

---

Add a parser for freestanding reference tables in the SRD 5.1 (kind=table): exhaustion levels (if not already covered by the condition parser), encounter difficulty thresholds, treasure tables, ability-check DC tables, etc. Each table becomes a kind=table record. The `table` kindSchema requires `data.columns: string[]` and `data.rows: unknown[][]`. `key` should be `table:<slug>`.

Note: table extraction from PDFs is genuinely harder than prose extraction — pdfjs reports text items with positions but does not preserve table semantics. The parser will likely need a per-table anchor + heuristic for row reconstruction. Start with the simplest tables (encounter difficulty thresholds, ability-check DCs) and document any tables that resist clean extraction so they can be re-attempted with a smarter extractor in a follow-up.

Split from the original 0m9.5.7 to keep ticket scope shippable in one session.
acceptance_criteria:
- Parser extracts at least the simple tables (encounter difficulty, ability-check DCs).
- Records satisfy dnd5e-srd table kindSchema (data.columns string array; data.rows array of arrays).
- Manifest description includes 'table' in Included record kinds.
- Tables that resist extraction are listed in the importer README with the reason and a follow-up beads issue link.
- Unit tests cover a simple two-column table and a multi-column table.
close_reason: Implemented SRD 5.1 reference-table parser for Difficulty Classes and XP Thresholds by Character Level; verification passed; TDD evidence recorded.
